kernel.governing_law: Every utterance in the scene — divine question, fraternal speech, murder, denial — is structurally posterior to a condition already accomplished before the utterance occurs; the drama is the surfacing of what was settled prior to its enactment.
kernel.mutated_relation: The scene spoken as its own antecedence — each act replaced by the condition that had to hold for the act to become speakable.
kernel.beats:
the LORD said -> the one who knew before asking disclosed
Why art thou wroth -> Thou art wroth, and I have seen it before thy face moved
why is thy countenance fallen -> Thy face was once lifted; it is no longer; the difference is legible
If thou doest well -> The criterion existed before thy hand moved
shalt thou not be accepted -> Acceptance was prepared; it waited; thou hast walked past it
sin lieth at the door -> Something crouches at the threshold thou hast not yet crossed
his desire -> He has already turned toward thee
thou shalt rule over him -> Mastery was assigned before it was exercised
Cain talked with Abel his brother -> Abel came near; Abel consented to the nearness
in the field -> The space was open and empty of witness
Cain rose up against Abel -> Abel was still, or lower, or trusting
slew him -> The body had a place to fall and the ground could receive it
Where is Abel thy brother -> Abel had a location and thou art the reason it is vacant
I know not -> A knowing was possible and refused
Am I my brother's keeper -> A keeping existed to be denied
What hast thou done -> The deed is already fully visible to the asker
the voice of thy brother's blood -> Blood has no voice until it is shed; the shedding gave it speech
crieth unto me -> A listener was listening before the cry
from the ground -> The ground received what was refused above it

independent.recovered_law: In TEXT A, events unfold as genuine questions, discoveries, and contingent actions (God asks not knowing, Cain chooses, sin threatens prospectively). In TEXT B, all knowledge, outcomes, and roles are predetermined and already completed before they occur—questions become disclosures of what is already known, contingent possibilities become pre-assigned facts, and agents become passive recipients of foreordained sequences.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe replacing live, contingent actions with their preconditions/predeterminations, but the recovered claim focuses on predestination and foreordained completion rather than specifically on each act being replaced by its speakability condition. The structural shift overlaps (contingency → predetermined antecedence) but the framing differs.
independent.terminal_note: The final portion maintains the changed relation: God's question becomes a disclosure of already-known facts, Cain's denial becomes a refused knowing, and the blood's cry is recast as a pre-existing listener hearing a predetermined speech.
